signal: Fiery launched FS700 Pro, Fiery XF 9, JobFlow Pro and the agentic AI tool Fiery Scribe across its print software lineup in 2026

email.body1:
Lori, saw Fiery shipped FS700 Pro, XF 9, and the agentic Fiery Scribe in quick succession.

A launch cadence like that floods the top of funnel, and the bottleneck becomes follow-up volume: more accounts in play than your reps can touch before signals go cold. Our AI SDR handles research, writing, and multi-channel follow-up, so your team books 3-5x more meetings without adding headcount.

I had our AI SDR draft 3 personalized emails to your top 3 target accounts. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through them?
email.body2:
Lori, quick follow-up for the Fiery team.

Most SDR teams lose deals not on intent but on speed and ramp: signals fire, reps are mid-sequence elsewhere, and new hires take months to get productive. Built-in best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and 3 specific things I would change so the team responds faster and ramps new reps quicker.
email.body3:
Lori, last bit of proof for Fiery.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other software teams. Want to grab time so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Lori, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If helping your reps cover more accounts without new hires isn't a focus this quarter, no problem at all. I know managing an SDR team through a launch cycle is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your team? I will tailor it to Fiery either way.
